scope: Local stock Lean and Palomar source intake. No hosted run.
summary: Each stock modular import of a legacy file failed at the header, including a transitive legacy chain imported across a package boundary.
The stock source scanner rejected legacy files, even if unused, and rejected the 10001-line fixture.
Modern chains, a modern ordinary proof-only import, a small genuinely merged modern file and a standalone legacy chain all built, exported and passed the stock kernel with zero axioms.
